svg.title: How rig works: rig up, rig sync, rig exec and rig browser, rig desktop, rig save.
svg.desc: Five steps. rig up starts the branch's cloud desktop. rig sync sends local edits. rig exec runs tests and rig browser drives its Chrome. rig desktop lets you see and control its screen. rig save makes a signed-in desktop the start of every new one.
svg.text: The loop your agent runs on every branch, in its own cloud desktop.
